name: Paid Content
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Vantage Point's first NBN cards — Nihilo Agent, Grubber, Paywall, Scapegoat — on Hyper Velocity's frame, under Making News. Eternal-legal only. Vantage Point Stage 3a: Hype Machine for AMAZE Amusements, Magistrate Revontulet for Nihilo Agent. Vantage Point Stage 4a: two Lethe for two Tithe. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 1: two Capacitor and two Seraph for three Ping and the Whitespace, which the deck's tags feed, and two The Powers That Be for two Hedge Fund. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 4a: two Kingmaking for two Orbital Superiority, for the Superconducting Hub to follow into the score area. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 4c: two Stoke the Embers for the last Orbital Superiority and the Offworld Office, for The Powers That Be to install out of Archives; The Holo Man for the Hansei Review and Janaína “JK” Dumont Kindelán for the Hedge Fund. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 5a: two Piranhas for a Funhouse and a Paywall, rezzed off the deck's tags, and two Sudden Commandment for two Predictive Planogram. The Automata Initiative Stage 1: two Balanced Coverage for two Public Trail, and two Behold! for the Spin Doctor and the Predictive Planogram. The Automata Initiative Stage 2: two Your Digital Life for two Scapegoat, two B-1001 for Public Trail and Tithe. The Automata Initiative Stage 3: two Virtual Service Agent for two Paywall, ice for ice. The Automata Initiative Stage 8d: two Oracle Thinktank for the Tomorrow's Headline and a Neurospike, point for point, for the Corp to take back off the tag it gives. Parhelion Stage 1: two Gaslight, two Nonequivalent Exchange, two Post-Truth Dividend and a third Kingmaking for its Neurospike, two Manegarm Skunkworks, two Funhouse, a Send a Message and its Superconducting Hub, point for point.
